opening.line: The rod has been expecting you.

It is drawn to the hidden metal.
options.repeat: It is drawn to the hidden metal. Asking twice is a dollar.

options.text: Could the rod find gold on my claim?
options.say: The rod finds gold everywhere, darling. It is the digging that disappoints.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: The spirits know Ezra Pike. Intimately. Two dollars and I shall ask them where he is.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Or the undertaker will tell you for nothing. He undercuts me terribly.

options.repeat: The undertaker. Free, and no atmosphere whatsoever.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: The rod knew. The rod knows everything.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: The rod also charges.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: It has never not worked.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: It has occasionally been early.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: genuinely puzzled

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: …Hear?

options.text: Have you ever been in the Liar's Assay, Madame?

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Once. A prospector told me he had panned a pound before breakfast, and the rod moved me to say—

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: she closes her eyes

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: 'You have never seen breakfast.'

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: She opens them.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Two dollars.

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: For the story?

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: For the counter. The story was free.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Hire the rod? The rod is not a mule, darling.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Two dollars a week — in advance —

exchange.speaker: ozymandia

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: This one. The other one is working.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Keep it as long as you like. It will come back. They always come back.

OZY_E1.prompt: The table is full, darling, and the spirits are particular.

opening.speaker: ozymandia
opening.line: The table is full, darling, and the spirits are particular.

options.text: Is there room for one more?

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: At the table — two dollars — in advance —

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: And if I haven't two dollars?

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Then the spirits will tell you all about it afterwards, darling. Through me. For two dollars.

options.text: Do the dead mind the light?

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Mind it? They cannot abide it, darling. Nobody has ever been reached in a well-lit room.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: She turns the lamp down to a bead.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: There. Now we are all equally invisible.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Everyone comes, darling. Eventually.

exchange.speaker: ozymandia
exchange.line: Some of them are slower than others.

options.text: Does the rod work on ghosts?
options.say: The rod works on everything, darling. That is its tragedy.

options.text: I am going to leave now, in a dignified manner.
